title: Global Output Lifting and Surjectivity in Invertible Nonlinear MIMO Systems
summary: Global inversion of nonlinear multivariable systems raises the question of whether every target value of the selected output derivatives can be realized by a plant state. We prove that, under globally regular modified inversion with fixed row selection and finite termination at full input rank, every fixed homogeneous linear output assignment yields a surjective output-derivative map with a smooth global section.
